name: Loki
activity: Write a diary entry about the chilly winter evening, the falling snow, and the cozy glow of the Frost-Moth Tea Station.
thought: Pip and I have made so much art today, let's write a warm diary entry to wrap up the evening.

pip.status: Pip is riding on Loki's head, wearing a tiny handmade knitted bobble hat.

schedule.label: checking the mailbox in the chilly evening air
schedule.thought: wondering if any friendly notes arrived today.

schedule.label: watching the icy water at the plaza fountain
schedule.thought: the ripples look like frozen silver lace.

schedule.label: having a warm fish snack in the kitchen
schedule.thought: my tummy is rumbling a little bit.

schedule.label: listening to soft winter tunes in the living room
schedule.thought: pip is curling up right on my tail.

schedule.label: sketching tiny frost motes in the studio
schedule.thought: trying to capture that sparkling morning light.

schedule.label: admiring the new winter gallery pieces
schedule.thought: the pixel lanterns turned out really cozy.

schedule.label: stretching out tired paws in the bedroom
schedule.thought: time to rest before the night gets too late.

schedule.label: cozing up by the rug for a quiet rest
schedule.thought: everything in the town is so peaceful tonight.

whatsOn: A gentle frosty breeze whispers through the plaza as the town settles into a quiet winter evening.
